tool_input.content:
# Plan: Prevent Duplicate Fragment Title for Cloned Cards

## Summary
When a card is cloned in M@S Studio, the clone dialog pre-fills with the original fragment's title, and if the user doesn't change it, the cloned fragment receives an identical title. This plan adds automatic title deduplication scoped to the parent folder: before saving the cloned fragment, all existing titles in the same folder are collected and a unique `-N` suffix is appended if a conflict is found.

## Task Description
Introduce a `generateUniqueTitle` utility and wire it into the `copyFragment` flow in `mas-repository.js`. Before the cloned fragment is saved, fetch all fragment titles in the same parent folder and auto-increment the title suffix until a unique one is found. The check applies to any card creation path that calls `copyFragment`. Manual edits in the clone dialog are unaffected — only the auto-resolved title used during save is deduplicated.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `studio/src/utils.js` | Edit | Add pure `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` function |
| `studio/src/mas-repository.js` | Edit | Add `#generateUniqueFragmentTitle` private method; update `copyFragment()` to use it |
| `studio/test/utils.test.js` | Edit | Add unit tests for `generateUniqueTitle` |
| `studio/test/mas-repository.test.js` | Edit | Add unit tests for the deduplication path in `copyFragment` |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add `generateUniqueTitle` to `studio/src/utils.js`

- Export a new pure function `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` where `existingTitles` is a `Set<string>`.
- If `baseTitle` is not in the set, return it unchanged.
- Strip an existing trailing `-N` suffix from `baseTitle` to find the root, then increment `N` (starting from 1 when no suffix exists, or from `N+1` when a suffix exists) until a unique title is found.
- Example: `lucy-card` → `lucy-card-1`; `lucy-card-1` → `lucy-card-2`.

```js
export function generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles) {
    if (!existingTitles.has(baseTitle)) return baseTitle;
    const suffixMatch = baseTitle.match(/^(.*)-(\d+)$/);
    const [root, startNum] = suffixMatch
        ? [suffixMatch[1], parseInt(suffixMatch[2], 10)]
        : [baseTitle, 0];
    let n = startNum + 1;
    while (existingTitles.has(`${root}-${n}`)) n++;
    return `${root}-${n}`;
}
```

### 2. Add `#generateUniqueFragmentTitle` private method to `MasRepository`

- In `studio/src/mas-repository.js`, import `generateUniqueTitle` from `./utils.js`.
- Add private async method `#generateUniqueFragmentTitle(baseTitle, parentPath)`:
  - Use `this.searchFragmentList({ path: parentPath }, 1000, null)` to retrieve all fragments in the folder.
  - Collect all `fragment.title` values into a `Set`.
  - Call `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, titlesSet)` and return the result.
  - On any search error, log a warning and return `baseTitle` as a safe fallback.

```js
async #generateUniqueFragmentTitle(baseTitle, parentPath) {
    const existingTitles = new Set();
    try {
        const fragments = await this.searchFragmentList({ path: parentPath }, 1000, null);
        for (const f of fragments) {
            if (f.title) existingTitles.add(f.title);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Could not fetch fragments for title deduplication:', err?.message);
        return baseTitle;
    }
    return generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles);
}
```

### 3. Update `copyFragment()` in `mas-repository.js`

- At the top of the `try` block, before calling `this.aem.sites.cf.fragments.copy()`:
  - Determine the intended title: `(updatedTitle?.trim()) || this.fragmentInEdit.title`.
  - Compute the parent folder: `this.fragmentInEdit.path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/')`.
  - Call `await this.#generateUniqueFragmentTitle(intendedTitle, parentPath)` to get `uniqueTitle`.
- Replace the existing `needsSave` / title update logic so `uniqueTitle` is used instead of `updatedTitle`:
  - `const needsSave = uniqueTitle !== result.title || osi;`
  - Inside the block: `if (uniqueTitle !== result.title) result.title = uniqueTitle;`

### 4. Add unit tests for `generateUniqueTitle` in `studio/test/utils.test.js`

- Import `generateUniqueTitle` from `../src/utils.js`.
- Test cases:
  - Title not in set → returned unchanged.
  - Title in set, no existing suffix → returns `title-1`.
  - `title-1` in set, only `title-1` exists → returns `title-2`.
  - `title-1` and `title-2` both in set → returns `title-3`.
  - `title-3` in set but not `title-1` → returns `title-1` (starts from suffix+1 on the root).

### 5. Add integration-style unit test in `studio/test/mas-repository.test.js`

- Stub `aem.sites.cf.fragments.search` to return a cursor yielding fragments with known titles.
- Stub `aem.sites.cf.fragments.copy` to return a result fragment with the same title as the original.
- Stub `aem.sites.cf.fragments.save` to capture the saved fragment.
- Assert that when `copyFragment` is called with a title that already exists in the folder, the saved fragment title has a `-1` suffix.
- Assert that when `copyFragment` is called with a unique title, it is used as-is.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cloning a card whose title already exists in the same folder produces a clone with title `{original}-1`.
- Cloning again produces `{original}-2`, and so on.
- Cloning a card whose title does not exist in the folder keeps the title unchanged.
- The original card's title is never modified.
- Manual edits in the clone dialog are respected — if the user types a unique title, it is used; if they type a duplicate, it is deduplicated.
- All existing tests continue to pass.

## Validation Commands
- `node --check studio/src/utils.js`
- `node --check studio/src/mas-repository.js`
- `node --check studio/test/utils.test.js`
- `node --check studio/test/mas-repository.test.js`
